learning_outcomes.text: To conduct studies related to fuel types.
To gain the ability to solve fuel problems individually.
To train engineers who will follow scientific technologies in combustion processes.
To solve and interpret combustion problems with a rational and scientific approach.
To provide students with literature review and presentation skills.

syllabus_topics: Solid and liquid fuel reserves in Turkey, energy policies
Definition of solid and liquid fuels and problem solving
Calculation of net and gross calorific values of coal
Definitions and calculation of heat loss through slag
Calculation of flue gas composition resulting from complete and partial combustion of coal
Calculation of solid fuel composition from flue gas analysis
Calculation of flue gas composition in sulfur-containing liquid fuels
Calculation of air required and percentage for combustion given flue gas composition
